findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Not done. The Done-when line requires each item to show its state and next step. After the owner opens Waiting or not started, this renderer displays only each title and key. A normal waiting row can already contain both a state and `next.step`—the changed board fixture includes `forge read WAIT`—but neither appears in the Board tab.
findings.title: Not done: Expanded waiting rows omit their state and next step

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. In an agent-merge repo, a ready item viewed on another machine has no local receipt or worktree. Forge says the person who started it merges from their machine, and the row has `next.step: null` (`tests/test_board_counts.py:210-225`). This fallback instead tells the viewer to merge the pull request directly, bypassing the configured `forge merge` path and its receipt checks (`src/forge/merge.py:41-51`).
findings.title: Ready rows on another machine suggest the wrong merge action

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Test. The mounted Board-tab test opens Waiting or not started but asserts only that the title appears. It passes while the renderer drops the row's state and next step. The grouped-board proof checks only the folded waiting count, so no entry-point test detects this missing Done-when behavior.

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Gate. The recorded allowance is for the grouped pane, but the diff also adds `step` to public `forge next --json` here, adds `needs_person` to `forge board --json` (`src/forge/board.py:505`), and changes the refresh timeout to 60 seconds (`src/forge/mod/hooks/register.ts:10`). That combines presentation, machine-interface, and refresh-behavior changes; it fails the stated one-kind, no-interface-change allowance rule.
findings.title: Recorded allowance covers multiple problems and interface changes

stop.proposed: cut the code that invites these findings; or replace the cases with one general rule; or narrow that Done when item; or make it fail closed
stop.reason: Owner chose one more round: ready rows always show 'ready to merge' and the merge step; a worker question shows how to answer it; both tested through the Board tab.
